items.title: Ford Foundation interview Interview, 1966-04-05
items.q: Mr. Fran Odenheimer, who is President of the New Orleans Symphony, and Mr. Lloyd Hawkins, who is President of the Opera Association, all of which and all organizations of which have been recipients of Ford Foundation Largettes.

ctx.x: The Tomorrow evening on Channel 8, WYES-TV and the NET Festival of the Arts proudly present Igor Stravinsky. The first half of this 90-minute profile on Stravinsky will be a thoughtful documentary on the composer's life. This former portion of the offering will compare the maestro's earlier years with his more recent ones to show how Stravinsky, now 83, is somehow as fascinating as ever. In the latter portion of the program, NET will be our host for an evening at the concert. Included in the program will be…

WYES-TV presents the Ford Foundation and the World of Culture. Your host is Vernon Cook. Good evening. I'm Vernon Cook. Our use of the globe there in the opening shot is more than casually symbolic, because the world of culture and the Ford Foundation seem to go hand in hand. Also, our use of an antique set, antique tables and chairs from the 18th century in this program are a way, kind of a gambit, if you will, of getting into definitions of culture, which are awfully difficult to define.
